PU_FAILURE_UNREACHABLE.description: Goal is no longer reachable for some reason - e.g., an obstacle blocks the path.

PU_FAILURE_TARGET_GONE.description: Target (for llPursue or llEvade) can no longer be tracked - e.g., it left the region or is an avatar that is now more than about 30m outside the region.

PU_FAILURE_NO_VALID_DESTINATION.description: There's no good place for the character to go - e.g., it is patrolling and all the patrol points are now unreachable.

PU_EVADE_HIDDEN.description: Triggered when an llEvade character thinks it has hidden from its pursuer.

PU_EVADE_SPOTTED.description: Triggered when an llEvade character switches from hiding to running

PU_FAILURE_NO_NAVMESH.description: This is a fatal error reported to a character when there is no navmesh for the region. This usually indicates a server failure and users should file a bug report and include the time and region in which they received this message.

PU_FAILURE_DYNAMIC_PATHFINDING_DISABLED.description: Triggered when a character enters a region with dynamic pathfinding disabled. Dynamic pathfinding can be toggled by estate managers via the 'dynamic_pathfinding' option in the Region Debug Console.

PU_FAILURE_PARCEL_UNREACHABLE.description: Triggered when a character failed to enter a parcel because it is not allowed to enter, e.g. because the parcel is already full or because object entry was disabled after the navmesh was baked.

DENSITY.description: Indicates that density parameter is enabled and will override the previous value.

FRICTION.description: Indicates that friction parameter is enabled and will override the previous value.

RESTITUTION.description: Indicates that restitution parameter is enabled and will override the previous value.

GRAVITY_MULTIPLIER.description: Indicates that gravity_multiplier parameter is enabled and will override the previous value.

LINDENDOLLAR_INSUFFICIENTFUNDS.description: The source agent does not have enough L$ for the transfer

LINDENDOLLAR_ENTITYDOESNOTEXIST.description: The destination UUID is not a valid agent.

LINDENDOLLAR_BADCLOCKSKEW.description: There is bad clock skew between the sim host and the L$ service

INVALID_DESTINATION.description: Destination agent is not a valid UUID

THROTTLED.description: The scripted L$ throttle was hit for this object owner.

MISSING_PERMISSION_DEBIT.description: The script does not have debit permission

GROUP_OWNED.description: The object is group owned and thus can't give money

TRANSFERS_DISABLED.description: L$ transfers are disabled in the region

EXPIRED.description: The simulator timed out waiting for a response from the back-end service.

SERVICE_ERROR.description: There was an error connecting to the back-end service

AGENT_AUTOMATED.description: Identifies an avatar registered with Linden Lab as an automated or scripted agent (bot).

AGENT_FLOATING_VIA_SCRIPTED_ATTACHMENT.description: Indicates that the agent is floating because of a scripted attachment using either llSetHoverHeight or llGroundRepel.

CHANGED_RENDER_MATERIAL.description: Prim material ID or material overrides have changed on one or more faces.

COMBAT_CHANNEL.description: A channel reserved for combat related log events broadcast to the entire region.

COMBAT_LOG_ID.description: Messages from the region to the combat log will all be from this ID.

DAMAGEABLE.description: If it is contained in the result of llDetectedType, it means what was detected is either an agent that can take damage, or is an object containing a script with either on_damage or final_damage events (able to process damage).

HTTP_EXTENDED_ERROR.description: HTTP request option for configuring extended error.

INVENTORY_MATERIAL.description: Used with Inventory functions and specifies inventory items of MATERIAL type will be retrieved by the function.

NAK.description: NAK is a value returned by the llGetNotecardLineSync function when the requested notecard data is not available due to the notecard not being in the region notecard cache. The value returned equals the characters with codes "10, 21, 10", which is to say the ASCII "NAK" character surrounded by two newline characters.

OBJECT_DAMAGE.description: Gets the damage amount delivered by a prim on collision.

OBJECT_DAMAGE_TYPE.description: Gets the damage type that is applied when this prim collides with another object. Can match one of the DAMAGE_TYPE_* constants, be a custom damage type or be a repurposed damage field.

OBJECT_GROUP_TAG.description: This is a flag used with llGetObjectDetails to get the active group tag/title of the avatar defined in key.

OBJECT_HEALTH.description: Gets the health of the object.

PARCEL_DETAILS_FLAGS.description: Used with llGetParcelDetails, see llGetParcelFlags for the meaning of the returned flags.

PERMISSION_GAME_CONTROL.description: Permission flag granting or identifying game control.

PERMISSION_PRIVILEGED_LAND_ACCESS.description: Required Permission to use the llSetParcelForSale() function.

PRIM_CLICK_ACTION.description: Which action will be taken when left-clicking the prim. Followed by one of these flags

PRIM_DAMAGE.description: Sets the damage amount and damage type delivered by a prim on collision.

PRIM_HEALTH.description: Used to get or set the health of the object. Objects start with 0 health by default.

PRIM_PROJECTOR.description: The light projection settings for this prim. If the prim is not a projector the texture key will be NULL_KEY.

PRIM_REFLECTION_PROBE.description: PRIM_REFLECTION_PROBE is used to change the reflection probe configuration of the prim. Usage: [ PRIM_REFLECTION_PROBE, float ambiance, float clip_distance, integer flags ]

PRIM_REFLECTION_PROBE_BOX.description: Used with PRIM_REFLECTION_PROBE. A reflection probe is a sphere by default, otherwise a box if this flag is set on the corresponding prim.

PRIM_REFLECTION_PROBE_DYNAMIC.description: Used with PRIM_REFLECTION_PROBE. A reflection probe does not image avatars by default, otherwise it images avatars if this flag is set on the corresponding prim. Imaging avatars in reflection probes has a performance cost.

PRIM_REFLECTION_PROBE_MIRROR.description: Used with PRIM_REFLECTION_PROBE. When enabled, objects with low-roughness PBR materials objects act as a mirror. Note that mirrors do not reflect avatars unless PRIM_REFLECTION_PROBE_DYNAMIC is also set. Rendering mirrors has a performance cost.

PRIM_RENDER_MATERIAL.description: Used to get or set the material settings of a prim's face. Usage: [ PRIM_RENDER_MATERIAL, integer face, string render_material ]

PRIM_SCULPT_FLAG_ANIMESH.description: PRIM_SCULPT_FLAG_ANIMESH is a read-only flag set when the object is an Animated mesh. Sculpted Prims: FAQ

PRIM_SCULPT_TYPE_MESH.description: When used in conjunction with type_sculpt_const a Mesh object produced.

REZ_DAMAGE.description: Sets the damage amount delivered by a prim on collision when the object is rezzed.

REZ_DAMAGE_TYPE.description: Sets the damage type when rezzed to apply when this prim collides with another object. Can match one of the DAMAGE_TYPE_* constants, be a custom damage type or be a repurposed damage field.

SIM_STAT_ACTIVE_SCRIPT_COUNT.description: Simulator statistic identifier for active script count.
